name: nuswhispers
description: Laravel API and admin with a static Void/React frontend.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
scripts.format: oxfmt frontend resources/js vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings frontend/src frontend/pages frontend/tests frontend/*.ts vite.config.ts resources/js
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check frontend resources/js vite.config.ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json
